blocks.content: Quiz: What does calling create() in Zustand return?
Tap an option below to answer:
A plain JavaScript object with your state
create() does not return a plain object — it returns a custom hook you call in components.
create() does not return a plain object — it returns a custom hook you call in components.
A Provider component you need to wrap your app with
Zustand does not require a Provider. That is one of the things that makes it simpler than other libraries.
Zustand does not require a Provider. That is one of the things that makes it simpler than other libraries.
A custom React hook you can use in any component
create() returns a custom hook — like useJournalStore — that any component can call to read from or update the store.
create() returns a custom hook — like useJournalStore — that any component can call to read from or update the store.
A class with methods for updating state
Zustand does not use classes. Your store is a plain JavaScript object with state and functions.
Zustand does not use classes. Your store is a plain JavaScript object with state and functions.
